errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die Kategorien der Technologien dar, während die vertikale Achse die Anteile in Prozent zeigt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The chart is a horizontal bar chart, where the vertical axis lists the categories (Plattformdienste, etc.) and the horizontal axis represents the values (Anteile in %).

errors.text_span: erreichen etwa 62-63% in allen drei Sektoren
errors.evidence: The values for 'Plattformdienste' are approximately 63%, 67%, and 65%. The stated range of 62-63% is too narrow and inaccurate, as two of the three bars are outside this range.

errors.text_span: wobei Managementinformationssysteme etwa 15-18%, Audiovisuelle Technologien etwa 10-12% und Internet der Dinge etwa 7-10% ausmachen
errors.evidence: The stated value ranges for these technologies are incorrect. The approximate values from the chart are: Managementinformationssysteme (12-15%), Audiovisuelle Technologien (8-10%), and Internet der Dinge (5-10%).

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert
errors.evidence: The categories on the vertical axis are sorted in descending order based on the length of the bars (i.e., the percentage value), from 'Plattformdienste' at the top (highest values) to 'Künstliche Intelligenz' at the bottom (lowest values).
